text: In accordance with Section 9A of the Consolidated Rules of Procedure for the Property Standards Committee, as amended, each Panel shall adopt a schedule of meetings to hear appeals for each year. Please note that meetings for the Property Standards Committee, North York Panel will be held remotely until further notice.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Approved the following meeting dates for 2024: - Wednesday, January 24 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, February 28 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, March 20 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, April 17 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, May 15 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, June 12 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, July 17 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, September 18 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, October 30 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, November 27 at 9:30 a.m.
